tools.name: scan_accounts
tools.description: 扫描一批 X 账号近 N 小时的帖子，按热度排序输出中文资讯日报（核心工具）。accounts 支持逗号分隔账号或预设包名（ai_llm/ai_dev/tech_news/crypto），可混合。

tools.name: search_x_news
tools.description: 按关键词搜索 X 帖子并按热度排序。注意：免费镜像搜索索引较浅，空结果不代表没有内容，主通道请用 scan_accounts。

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: 读取单条 X 帖子详情（含 views/媒体信息），接受帖子 URL 或数字 id。

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: 列出内置精选账号包（scan_accounts 可直接引用包名）。

tools.name: reset_seen
tools.description: 清空已见去重库（下次扫描会把时间窗内命中帖当新帖再推一遍，慎用）。

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_post · Public sink: get_post · Destructive: reset_seen.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_post · Public sink: get_post · Destructive: reset_seen

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
